nom: MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Skin Balancing Hydration Serum

avis.texte: I am obsessed with this serum because it leaves my skin hydrated and perfectly primed for makeup application! I feel like my makeup looks so much better since I added this to my routine!
Smells great, goes on as a light serum and does a good job balancing skin to prevent oily/dry skin to prevent breakout. Wish you got more volume of product for the price.

avis.titre: Really Good Product, Need Fragrance Free
avis.texte: Performs well under makeup. My skin looks and feels hydrated after application. Wish there was a fragrance-free option.

avis.titre: Great unless you have issues with hyaluronic acid...
avis.texte: I bought this product after it was sampled on me in the store, and it made my skin feel so soft! Unfortunately, I broke out from it and I found out soon after that hyaluronic acid makes me break out. I was really sad I had to discontinue using this, but I'd still recommend it to anyone who doesn't have issues using products containing hyaluronic acid.
I really like this serum before my makeup and really trust me is the best product, my makeup now is so smooth and people tell me how I get my makeup like that effect
I'm in love with this serum, I have been using it for well over 6 months, and my skin is so soft and my hyper-pigmentation and redness are so much less noticeable.

I purchased this product to use with a the MAC Studio Radiance Serum Powered Foundation. After using the Hyper Real Serumizer my skin was completely moisturized and prepped for makeup. My makeup applied flawlessly and didn't pill. I will definitely purchase this again! It's a quick way to get your serum and moisturizer done quickly!

avis.titre: Best serum for hydration and base for makeup
avis.texte: I do really love this serum, it gives the best hydration and will not break you out! I love how my skin glows. It's a perfect base as well for makeup. It's not pilling under foundation.
I love the feel of this! It's so smooth and goes on silky. It doesn't get sticky or feel heavy. Hydrates and feels great. I can't wait to see how it does over time.

I ordered this in a kit over the winter holidays and absolutely fell in love with it. It made my skin satin smooth and was perfect for foundation prep. It also kept my skin hydrated in the cold winter months.

I've been using the Hyper Real Serumizer™ and I really love how lightweight it feels on my skin. It absorbs quickly but still gives that deep hydration that makes my skin look fresh and healthy. After using it consistently, my skin looks smoother and more even, and my makeup applies beautifully on top of it. What I like most is how it gives that soft, natural glow without feeling heavy or greasy. It honestly makes my skin feel balanced and more refined overall. Definitely one of those products that makes your skin look good even before foundation. ✨

I love this product so much. It completely transformed my skin. I had acne scars which really showed hyperpigmentation. Over time my skin looked smoother, brighter and even toned. I'm also on the dry side. It's such a hydrating product. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly moisturized and glowy but doesn't leave me looking like a disco ball. I also use it as a primer. I hope one day they make a fragrance out of it too. It smells so beautiful
My face fills so plummeted and hydrating. Is lightweight and my face fills so moisturized all day

I received a sample of the serumizer in an order quite a while ago and was impressed. I kept putting it in my cart, removing it, putting it back in, and so on, but when it popped up on sale I grabbed it. This is probably the best serum I personally have ever used. It feels so good! I own a lot of serums and they typically are not worth the price but this one is.

Hyper real serumizer helped balance and change my skin. After I cleanse and tone I apply serumizer after a complete full bottle use my skin is clearer and smoother. I also use this to prep my skin for makeup routine and it is game changing how it helps my foundation apply and the finish is perfect
I have mature skin and this is very light. I like that the fragrance is just about non existent and works as a line of products. Will continue to purchase and use.
I love to use this + the Hyper Real moisturizer after my Rx retin A!
Love this serumizer. My skin is typically on the dry side, during the winter months and this has been a life saver.

I have used a lot of primers over the years and never found one I love as much as this one. I bought it bc my skin is so dry this time of year and it was on sale but I am now hooked! It is so smooth and my skin feels fantastic! Great product will purchase again.

I tried a little sample of this when I was desperate to find any kind of moisturizer and almost instantly this helped my skin. Over the course of a week the difference was insane and I ordered the full size. Now after almost a month of wearing it I am so happy with my decision to purchase. The Mac skincare should not be slept on, because the comfort cream helped me through my acutane journey years ago and now this product has helped my dry skin tremendously, preventing dry flakes around my mouth and nose when other products weren't able to do the same. I wish I took before and after photos because it's a ridiculous transformation. I love this product!
I love this serum. I keep coming back to it. I think I have bought about 5 bottles now.
I tried different serums but I found this is the best one …will recommend to everyone

Stop. This is what you've been searching for. Fantastic product! Lady that was working the make-up counter recommended this for my dry skin and I'm truly amazed. I've searched for years looking for a product for my dry skin and this has been a blessing - no oily residue, skin feels refreshed, and the light scent of fragrance is addictive.
Hydrates and reduces dark spots without leaving your skin oily. It is lightly scented. I love it!

I received a sample of this, then ended up buying a bottle. It's a great serum for under makeup, and I love how it makes my skin feel and look. I don't use this everyday as I'm slightly sensitive to niacinamide, and it's one of the featured ingredients.

I am on my 3rd bottle of this product. I think it works. i think my makeup applications looks great with this under and i feel like my skin looks more alive and healthyvwhen i wear it. Looks more plump. I love applying it. It feels good. Glides on perfectly. The only reason i gave it 4 starts is because there is fragrance. I smells delicious dont het me wrong but id perfect zero scent.

First received this as a free sample and was disappointed it wasn't a more exciting item. Boy was I wrong! Sometimes it's the boring stuff that changes your life. I use the serum every day and was so happy to grab the full size on sale. Definitely plan on repurchasing this for the rest of my life. It gives my skin moisture and radiance. It look beautiful on its own and works wonderfully with makeup.

avis.auteur: Mac user since 98 as a young lady
avis.texte: I love the Hyper real line , I tried to use something less expensive but my skin never felt the same, this product line is one of the best !

After I used the sample, I ordered more immediately! My skin instantly began to heal, looked brighter and more hydrated (very important to me) and it felt so butter smooth! I've been struggling for 2 years now with treating my face and this product worked best after all this time. I'm so happy I tried it.

avis.titre: Daily must! With or without makeup
avis.texte: I live how weightless this feels, the scent is pleasant yet not strong and it looks great under my makeup! Great!

avis.titre: HOLY GRAIL! GET IT AND DON'T THINK TWICE
avis.texte: Just get it. I was looking to find some new skin prep for use under makeup as my old routine wasn't jiving with my makeup anymore. I saw makeup artists suggesting this. I first began just using it under makeup and was so impressed just how healthy and alive it made your skin look. I reshuffled my entire skincare routine a few months ago and replaced virtually everything with an affordable alternative from Korea or Prequel/Naturium. This is the ONLY skincare product I will continue to purchase that is not affordable. I couldn't help myself at one point I was using it morning and night because I just love it. Since I was going through it so fast and starting only allowing myself to use it in the AM. After skin flooding, I do my Azelaic Acid, then Serumizer, than Korean sunscreen. My skin has never looked better. I have gotten so many people hooked on it. One of the best products ever created -- I am not being hyperbolic. Literally cannot live without this stuff.

I'm not one to spend this much on a product but it is a multitasker. It is a great consistency for a moisturizer and it works as a primer too, so I just use one product instead of two. It's also great to use by itself on days I go makeup free, and it provides a nice glow as well. Love this product

it can be used as a light moisturizer if you're oily. if you're normal to combo use it under the mac balm. HOWEVER, it did pill on me. I found a work around. when you apply it make sure your face is moist. I spritz water, hypochlorus acid spray or even fix + for a boost of moisture. then put this on. and don't use a ton....less is more. it does have salicylic acid in it..so it does keep oil and pimples at bay....if you happen to breakout...it could be you are congested...and didn't know it. (alot of people don't take proper care of their skin and don't realize it) . I then put on the moisturizer balm. it works great under makeup.
ULTA staff is always friendly and they have the best products!

avis.titre: MUST have in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: This stuff is AMAZING and feels great on the skin! I have very sensitive skin, but it doesn't break me out at all..I use the cream cleanser as step one, then I spray my face with Fix Plus Magic Radiance, then I apply this serum (I never tried the under eye serum) Honestly, I use this face serum all over my face and also under eye, then I apply the balm afterwards..This routine has become a game changer for me..My skin has never looked better! I was hoping not to love this routine because of the cost of using so many products, but I must say, it's worth every penny and a little goes a long way with all of these skincare products, so it's definitely worth it..The craziest thing I've experienced with this product (and I swear, this isn't sponsored at all..lol) I had a very small line by my mouth that was driving me crazy..I even tried filler to get rid of it and it still showed..After my Mac skincare routine, the line is completely gone! I was truly amazed..I am not sure if it's the cleanser, the fix plus, the serum or the balm that got rid of it, but I couldn't be happier about that! If you are on the fence about purchasing Mac's skincare, just do it! I promise you'll thank me later! Thank you so much Mac!
I use this as skin prep /primer for my combo skin and it's all I need. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Best product of MAC - SKIN HYDRATION SERUM
avis.texte: I am using it daily and its too good. I see reduction in dark spots and hydrates the skin
Just finished my first bottle of this and about to buy more. Definitely noticed a difference with my skin texture and tone while using this product.

Hi there -- I am purely a Cerave moisturizer gal, as my dermatologist has told me to be. But this product, combined with the Studio Fix Foundation, has made me very, very happy with my foundation step. It's been a journey through too-heavy and too-light coverage, but two pumps of serumizer and one pump of studio fix is the *perfect* blend for coverage but not opacity, no pesky creasing in the wrinkles, etc. I suspect the Studio Radiance formulation is just serumizer and studio fix, but I prefer to make my own blend.
I'm not acne prone at all but this caused me a bunch of acne-like bumps on my face and neck. Not sure if it's because I used it as skin care instead of a "primer" for makeup.

I don't have sensitive skin but have experienced burning, irritated skin from products containing BAD ingredients. Every time I'm about to purchase a new product I always read the bad reviews to see what folks say, even if it has overall glowing reviews. I then googled the first 5 ingredients after water and just LOL. This product is NOT good for the skin. The name is deceiving because it sounds like it's a skincare product and it's not. It's to be used underneath your makeup, like a primer.

This didn't leave my skin petal smooth, and my dark spots still rule my pale face. It feels nice on my skin, but that's about it. Most frustrating is the packaging. The pump isn't great at getting all of the product out. I've been storing the bottle upside down, unscrewing the top and tapping out the serum onto the back of my hand for the last 1/3 of the bottle. Meh.

I don't like fragranced skin prouducts but this is a light scent. It feels nice on the skin and works great if you use in the morning after sleeping with moisturizer on. Then just using this before makeup. My makeup stays put better this way vs using with a moistuizer. If using with a moisturizer, make sure it dries down completely before foundation or concealer

I tried this as a sample from the store. After using it once I went right back and bought a bottle!! My skin felt amazing and was baby smooth. I've noticed my skin looks so much better even under my makeup. This is hands down a great product and will always be in my routine!! My skin looks smooth and my pores look smaller. It does everything it says.
The japanese peony extract instantly softens the skin…unlike any other serum ive tried. Its amazingggg

Love the MAC serumizer! Makes my skin so soft, smooth & ever so lightly hydrated. Great for a no-makeup day, but mainly I use it as a second step aftee moisturizer in my pre makeup routine. Makeup applies flawlessly over it. Works as an excellent primer too making a perfect base for makeup. Im 43 with dry skin.
I use this serum as a primer and it works really well with any foundation i use and it has skin care benefits. Great product.

I do like it. I don't love it. first off in order to not have any flaking. you need to make sure your face is moist when spreading this over. I would use fenty fat water then immediately apply this and then the skin canvas balm...as I have combo skin. it didn't do anything extraordinary that would make me repurchase it. it is expensive for what it does as well. and it is lightly scented so buyer beware. it works OK under makeup.

I like the way it feels, however as the day progresses it starts to pill and flake. I've experimented with other serums and my makeup and deduced this is the culprit. guess it is a no makeup day appropriate
I've been using it for a couple of weeks now and my skin looks better in so many ways. Brighter, moisturized and more lively. It's definitely apart of my routine now.

For some reason, I was leery about trying the Mac skin care. The serum has been really great. I've had a lot of larger pores near my nose and it has shrunk them considerably. Definitely help make my skin glow. This is a very solid product to use if you're looking for something to help clear up your skin, increase flow, and be a good canvas for your make up.

avis.titre: One of my Go-To Skincare Items
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for almost 2 years now, and my skin has never looked better. It provides me the hydration my skin needs, and creates a balanced skin barrier. It has everything my skin needed to feel good, and I will continue to buy!

The MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Skin Balancing Hydration Serum is wonderful! It adds just the right amount of moisturizer that it absorbs quickly into your skin but leaves just the right amount of moisture on your skiin. I am very happy with the Serumizer.
I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes. I enjoy this cream it is moisturizing and nice on my skin. I would recommend this product to my friends.
The Mac eye serum feels gentle and smells amazing. I have seen much difference after using for couple of weeks. My eyes feel more awake and brighter

avis.titre: I swear by this product now
avis.texte: The difference this product has made in my makeup is unreal! I cannot live without this product! I have dry skin and it has transformed how my makeup goes on!

This dissolves into the skin without any greasy residue. It also comes with a light, pleasant scent. I don't see any anti-aging benefits, per say, but this is fun to try and I'd buy it agin during a sale.
I tried this out when mac had a sale & now i reorder it every time there's a sale. Its great under makeup, smoothing & hydrating

I cannot overstate how many serums I've tried throughout the years. This is the very first one that I noticed an improvement in my overall skin immediately, and it only got better from there. If you're older you definitely need this! No reason to spend 100+ dollars on another serum that doesn't compare. And, if you're younger, you need this! You'll get older skin one day and in the meantime, this serum will just help your actual skin look flawless while making your makeup application look that much prettier.

It's highly fragranced and the travel size pump didn't even work. I do not recommend this if you have sensitive skin. Otherwise it would've been just fine without fragrance. Smh. On My face no thanks. I didn't get this from ulta I got it from mac just to be clear.

To preface, I have oily skin that has dehydrated spots. This serum has been so great at balancing the oils in my face and providing a well hydrated canvas for makeup! After using this serum, I don't find the need to reach for a face primer.
Received this as a sample and I love it Make my skin looking smooth underneath my makeup
I don't need makeup with this moisturizer. It works magic. But when I am doing a full face of makeup it makes my foundation look smooth and natural.

I really like this product. I apply it under foundation and it make a huge difference in the appearance of the foundation. It feels great on my skin. One pump is all that is needed for the entire face. I apply with fingers or a brush.

I have been using now for almost a month and my skin is so healthy looking. My dark spots or problem areas are almost gone. The smell is so pleasant and not over powering like other products I've tried, it is a soothing light sent that smells clean. I do pair this with all recommend products for my morning and evening routine and now have started my auto ship, save money and get great products replenished.

I really like this MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Skin Balancing Hydration Serum. It is super easy to use and a little goes a long way and has nice lasting power. It is easy to use and easy to apply. It blends well and easily. It feels soothing on skin also. I highly recommend!
Absolutely love the smell and the hydrating power. My skin feels softer after a few uses. The only complaint is it is way too shimmering for night use
It glides on silky smooth. My favorite to use under makeup. I love it!
I love how smooth and moisturized this product makes my face feel! Amazing!
I love this serum so much, it makes my skin look flawless. It fades the spots while using regularly. This is my 2nd bottle, totally in love with this!!
This is perfect for setting my face before applying my foundation, it really helps elevate my look
I actually love this serum so much! It makes my skin feel so silky and smooth - it's got a great light smell and it's a must have!

I chose this product as a free item from an order. It is fantastic! I planned to use it as a serum only, but after applying, it left my skin so smooth I decided that a primer was not needed. My make up application went on extremely well and lasted the entire day.
It didnt give me much hydration as I expected. The biggest issue for me would be the fragrance. I wish it was fragrance free.
I like this for the winter. Although it's more expensive than I'd like to pay.

I have sensitive skin w/rosacea. Been using the same products for years and thought my skin was as good as it could to get. While in Ulta, I was getting color matched for MAC foundation and the MUA put this on first and I almost heard my skin sigh.
Love this product. Super smooth skin - and muse both on with and without make-up. It also smells really good.
I love to use this with the moisturizer, and my skin feels so fresh and hydrated. I love the clean scent as well. I've added these to my daily routine
This product is so good! I have oily combination sking and it works wonders. Dont hesitate to try it.

avis.titre: Has changed my skin dramatically ! So happy I found this
avis.texte: My skin has done a 360 and all I have done was add the hyper real routine to my skin care. I use the wash and The serum…. The serum I use at night and also wear as my makeup primer. The way my skin looks smooth all day and looks hydrated and healthy! After 6 weeks my dark spots and pigment issues are gone! Highly recommend !! I haven't felt this confident in my own skin in a long time! Everything about the Hyper real skin care is perfection!!!!

I actually liked this product. As I age (and add the stress of this child) my face has changed and not for the better. I actually have seen a little difference in my face with this. it has become more brighter and I feel a difference when I use it. I don't use it everyday because I don't want my face to get used to it. So I use it every couple of days. I use it at bedtime, because it doesn't work with makeup during the day. at least for me it doesn't because even though my face get dry sometimes, it gets oily during the day and with the makeup it becomes weird. I hope this makes sense. honestly everyone face/skin is different and you won't know unless you try it. So far it was ok for me. get a sample and try it a few times. that's the best advice I can give. oh and remember how I said adding the stress to my face because of this child? yaaa, well.... he was being silly in the bathroom and knocked over my serum and it broke **smacking forehead and becoming sad as I write this** big sighhhh**. over and out. xoxo
This product is super hydrating, brings a glow to your skin, and smells amazing. This has been a game changer for my oily skin. It has my makeup looking FLAWLESS.
The perfect prep for your base. The serum feels so refreshing and hydrating. The silky smooth texture sinks into the skin quickly and allows the foundation to glide on
Put this on after the moisturizer from Mac and your make up will be flawless!

Not a standout serum in my collection but I enjoyed the iridencsent packaging and formula which made it extra fun to apply! Not an offensive scent and it helped my skin to feel moisturized after my shower.

This serum is highly moisturizing and goes on very smooth, I love the brush it came with and applying the serum with it. It feels like luxurious and adds to my nighttime routine. My skin feels very nice after applying and I love how soft it has become. This is a new favorite, and I will definitely be repurchasing!

I obtained a sample from Macy's store. I have never used serum before. I wanted something that would give my skin evenness, moisture and youthfulness. I found that the Mac serumizer is fantastic! My pores have gotten smaller, blemishes are going away and my skin is looking beautiful and youthful! I ended up purchasing the 1.7 Oz from Mac online. I still have half of the bottle left but since they have a good sale I will be purchasing another bottle so that I don't run out. It's a must try!
This Serum is something you don't even know you needed until after you've tried it. The true proof is actually on the days I DONT wear makeup..my skin is firmer, softer, more balanced.

Goes great under the moisturizer with this line. Also goes great with other products. It smells amazing. It leaves my skin hydrated and glowing. I use it at primarily at night. I have been using this line for over a year. I also like that it lasts awhile as well and I only have to restock a few times a year.

I saw so many good video reviews on this, especially for under makeup, so I couldn't wait to try it. After a couple of times, I notices it would peel when I wore without makeup and makeup didnt lay as great over. Ill use it night time, but thats about it.

This hydrating serum is very good! It glides on smooth & non-greasy. I didnt realize i liked it so much until i ran out. Then missed that smooth silky feeling it left when i was wearing it, so im getting my 2nd bottle soon.

I am on my third bottle of this serum, and I now find it hard to live without. I have combination skin with dry patches on my nose and chin so this product is a must have for me. I like to use it to prep my skin before applying makeup and at night. My skin has improved and I find it hard to go a day without it. This serum is unlike anything I have ever used and the only con is the price and wishing it came with more.
The serum hydrates my face throughout the whole day it doesn't leave a cast nor does it make my skin look or feel greasy.
I love this stuff. I struggle with hormonal acne, dry skin, and redness. This serum takes it all away and my skin feels so smooth. Love the smell and it has all the ingredients you need in one serum.
I was able to try out the Hyper Real Serumizer™ Skin Balancing Hydration Serum and I loved it. It moisturizes really well. Made my skin glowy and radiant all day.

avis.titre: Leaves my face moisturized for hours.
avis.texte: This moisturizer paired with the brush is a perfect package and I love that I can just use the brush for application. After using this my face is nice and moistures all day. Not drying or oily skin just a nice glow. I always feel my hands don't do well because my hands absorb most of the products before applying it but with this brush the problem is solved.

I received this for free in exchange for a review of the product. I tried it for an entire week and absolutely loved it! I have dry skin around my nose and forehead, and this serum kept my skin glowing! I shared some of the product with my mom because I loved it so much and she also loved it. I would definitely recommend it!
I rarely break out from products but this is the first time I break out and its really bad!!! I have acne all over my face now. I don't recommend at all.

avis.titre: not good for my dry skin
avis.texte: It is not good to use at all! it gave me acne it also peels from my face and rolling out . I'm very dad to say it but I will need to put it to garbage ☹️

avis.titre: A fun new addition to your skin care!
avis.texte: As a girl who loves skin care, I am always on the lookout for the next best product that will help me manage my dry skin! This serum has felt amazing every time I use it, like I have added a hydrating mask to my skin that lasts for the rest of the day. It leaves my skin feeling soft and ready for any other product that I am using on top. I have loved the way that it has helped my makeup lay better! Buy it and try it, it's worth it!
Super easy to absorb and very moisturizing serum. I felt very hydrated and plump under my makeup.

This felt really good applying during the day, especially right before i applied my makeup. My skin felt hydrated and made my makeup look super glowy. At night, it feels like a moisturizing mask. I loved this product! Would definitely want to get this again.

avis.titre: I will definitely purchase this product again.
avis.texte: I love this product! I have been using this for about a month and it really has made a difference in my appearance. People at work noticed the difference and asked me what I was using. One friend went out and got it to try it out for herself. I ame one very happy customer !

avis.titre: I usually don't review products but 😍😍
avis.texte: I am typically aomeone who reads reciews but never leaves my own but let me tell you 😍 This product is the best ive used! I strugglw with extremely dry and flakey skin on my face. Ive tried so many moisturizers but I hate how heavy they felt on my skin. This product is lightweight, cooling to my iritated skin, and completely changed the appearance and texture of my skin in less than a week. Don't let the price scare you away, its WELL worth every penny!

avis.titre: Unlike any other serum on the market.
avis.texte: This is something i consider a staple in my skincare and makeup routine. Its perfect plain and simple.
This serum was very hydrating and left my skin feeling nice and refreshed! Definitely recommend if you have dry skin or skin that needs alittle pick me up.
I received this product as a sample and has visibly improved the look of my skin. I will be purchasing.

I recently had the pleasure of trying out this serum free for review and I must say, it has truly transformed my skincare routine. After just a few weeks of using my skin has a radiant glow that I haven't experienced with other products. It gives my complexion a healthy and luminous appearance, making me feel confident even without makeup. One of the standout features of this serum is its ability to deeply hydrate my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. It's perfect for my combination skin, leaving it moisturized throughout the day without clogging pores.
